title: Godot 4.7-dev3: shows `GDScriptFunctionState` script errors
body:
### Tested versions

- No issues on versions before v4.7.dev3
- Reproducable since v4.7.dev3.official [60fff00a6]


### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

Since Godot 4.7-dev3 is see this error on plugin start
```shell
Loading GdUnit4 Plugin success
  ERROR: core/object/gdtype.cpp:116 - Condition "!Thread::is_main_thread()" is true.
```
And an additional error when running tests
```
Godot Engine v4.7.dev3.official.60fff00a6 - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.4.325 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti

GdUnit4 TCP Server:	Client connected -9223369413233639205
  ERROR: In Object of type 'GDScriptFunctionState': Attempt to connect nonexistent signal 'completed' to callable 'GDScriptFunctionState::_signal_callback'.
  ERROR: res://addons/gdUnit4/src/core/command/GdUnitCommandStopTestSession.gd:21 - Error connecting to signal: completed during await.
  ERROR: In Object of type 'GDScriptFunctionState': Attempt to connect nonexistent signal 'completed' to callable 'GDScriptFunctionState::_signal_callback'.
  ERROR: res://addons/gdUnit4/src/ui/parts/InspectorTreeMainPanel.gd:1200 - Error connecting to signal: completed during await.
  ERROR: In Object of type 'GDScriptFunctionState': Attempt to connect nonexistent signal 'completed' to callable 'GDScriptFunctionState::_signal_callback'.
  ERROR: res://addons/gdUnit4/src/core/command/GdUnitCommandStopTestSession.gd:21 - Error connecting to signal: completed during await.
--- Debugging process stopped ---
  ERROR: In Object of type 'GDScriptFunctionState': Attempt to connect nonexistent signal 'completed' to callable 'GDScriptFunctionState::_signal_callback'.
  ERROR: res://addons/gdUnit4/src/core/command/GdUnitCommandStopTestSession.gd:21 - Error connecting to signal: completed during await.
  ERROR: In Object of type 'GDScriptFunctionState': Attempt to connect nonexistent signal 'completed' to callable 'GDScriptFunctionState::_signal_callback'.
  ERROR: res://addons/gdUnit4/src/ui/parts/InspectorTreeMainPanel.gd:1200 - Error connecting to signal: completed during await.
```

The errors displayed are very strange, and it is impossible to determine the actual cause based on this information.

### Steps to reproduce

- install Godot v4.7.dev3.official [60fff00a6]
- install GdUnit4 v6.1.3
- activate the plugin and restart.
At restart you see the error
`ERROR: core/object/gdtype.cpp:116 - Condition "!Thread::is_main_thread()" is true.`
- run a test e.g.
```
func test_is_true1() -> void:
	assert_bool(true).is_true()
```
it shows a lot of 
```
ERROR: In Object of type 'GDScriptFunctionState': Attempt to connect nonexistent signal 'completed' to callable 'GDScriptFunctionState::_signal_callback'.
```
The error messages are not helpfull, I have no clue from where is comming.
A stacktrace would be helpfull.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

n/a
